English

[edit]

Noun

[edit]

rango (plural rangos or rangoes)

  1. Alternative form of arango.

Anagrams

[edit]
  • nagor, grano, angor, organ, groan, rag on, Goran, Organ, Ongar, Angor, Agron, argon, Garon, Rogan, Grano, Ragon, orang, Ronga

Chavacano

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Inherited from Spanish rango.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈranɡo/, [ˈrãŋ.ɡo]
  • Hyphenation: ran‧go

Noun

[edit]

rango

  1. rank

Esperanto

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈranɡo/
  • Audio 1:(file)
  • Audio 2:(file)
  • Rhymes: -anɡo
  • Syllabification: ran‧go

Noun

[edit]

rango (accusative singular rangon, plural rangoj, accusative plural rangojn)

  1. rank (grade)

Derived terms

[edit]
  • altranga
  • antaŭrangi
  • rangi

Further reading

[edit]
  • “rango”, in Plena Ilustrita Vortaro de Esperanto [Complete Illustrated Dictionary of Esperanto], 2020, →ISBN
  • “rango”, in Reta Vortaro [Online Dictionary] (in Esperanto), 1997-2026

Italian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from French rang.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈran.ɡo/
  • Rhymes: -anɡo
  • Hyphenation: ràn‧go

Noun

[edit]

rango m (plural ranghi)

  1. rank (grade)
  2. station (social standing)
  3. degree or class

Anagrams

[edit]
  • Grano, Ragno, argon, grano, ragno, rogna

Japanese

[edit]

Romanization

[edit]

rango

  1. Rōmaji transcription of らんご

Māori

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From Proto-Polynesian *laŋo (compare with Hawaiian nalo) from Proto-Oceanic *laŋo (compare with Samoan lago), from Proto-Malayo-Polynesian *laŋaw (compare with Malay langau (“horsefly”)), from Proto-Austronesian *laŋaw.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈraŋo/ [ˈɾɐŋɔ]

Noun

[edit]

rango

  1. fly (insect)
  2. blowfly

Synonyms

[edit]
  • ngaro (Western dialects)

References

[edit]
  • “rango” in John C. Moorfield, Te Aka: Maori–English, English–Maori Dictionary and Index, 3rd edition, Longman/Pearson Education New Zealand, 2011, →ISBN.

Verb

Spanish

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from French rang (“row”).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈranɡo/ [ˈrãŋ.ɡo]
  • Rhymes: -anɡo
  • Syllabification: ran‧go

Noun

[edit]

rango m (plural rangos)

  1. rank
  2. status, prestige
  3. (statistics) range (difference between largest and smallest observation)
    rango de edad ― age range
    • 2023 March 7, Cristina Galindo, “Los ingresos de la plataforma de ropa Zalando se estancan y anuncia “cientos” de despidos”, in El País‎[1]:
      En 2023, el objetivo es que los ingresos oscilen en un rango del -1% al 4% en comparación con 2022.
      (please add an English translation of this quotation)

Descendants

[edit]
  • Chavacano: rango
  • → Tagalog: ranggo

Further reading

[edit]
  • “rango”, in Diccionario de la lengua española [Dictionary of the Spanish Language] (in Spanish), online version 23.8.1, Royal Spanish Academy [Spanish: Real Academia Española], 15 December 2025

Anagrams

[edit]
  • argón, grano

Noun

rango

References

Verb

rango
